name: FX Pad
description: The board as a performance multi-effect: line 1/2, line 3/4, the mics and the computer through thirty-two effects in two banks the pads hold, an XY surface for their parameters; the one app of the fxpad firmware kit
changelog: 0.2.4: ROUTE shows the third output, USB / Rec, whole -- it stood half below the page, its second line hidden and its lower half out of a finger's reach; the three outputs are spaced evenly, OUT 3/4 level with the FX box. BAND SWEEP is BAND SWP on its tile and everywhere else: the long name lost its last letter on the FX tab. Host test of the screen on LVGL (tests/test_fx_ui.cpp): nothing on any tab is cut by what it sits in, every output answers a tap
0.2.3: runs in the PC simulator too (crosspad-pc kit fxpad, its own IFxBus over the simulator's mixer: IN1 = the mics, IN2 = Line 1/2, no Line 3/4, nothing in over USB)

0.2.2: SWAP X/Y on EDIT moves the two parameters under the finger -- it changed only the names on the screen, so X went on setting the parameter the pad now showed on Y; the swap is kept across a restart. TAIL is offered only on the effects that ring out (the delays, the reverbs, FREEZE, ECHO FRZ): on the others the key is dim and RELEASE reads SNAP, which is how they always stopped; FLANGER and PHASER default to SNAP; the power button's click lets go of held, HOLD and LATCH effects as KILL does (they started again in the next block); a pad no longer waits while a setting is saved (the save runs at the next screen tick, off the pads' lock); the encoder group is the framework's to restore
0.2.1: a finger run sideways across the XY pad stays on the pad -- the screen-wide back swipe took it as KILL and every effect stopped a short way into the gesture

0.2.0: bank B -- sixteen effects that cut the sound up (stutter, beat repeat, glitch, slicer, reverse, tape stop, spinback, scratch, grain, pitch, auto filter, pump, lofi, ring mod, echo freeze, pan chop) on the last seconds of the input, BANK on FX; USB REC on ROUTE puts USB in its audio profile so a phone or a computer records the FX; the XY pad redraws only the cursor (edge ticks and dots instead of whole-pad lines) at a 16 ms refresh

0.1.0: FX Pad: sixteen effects (echo, tape echo, ping pong, roll, hall, shimmer, freeze, gate, LP / HP filter, band sweep, wah, flanger, phaser, bitcrush, drive) on the pads, two at once with LATCH, X/Y on the touch surface, WET from the pad's pressure; TAIL or SNAP on release, synced to the tempo; ROUTE picks the sources (line 1/2, line 3/4, mics, USB), their sends, PRE/POST, MONO, THRU and the outputs (phones, line out, USB); over core 2.47's IFxBus
